title: The Nature Book
setting: A bright living room with a large picture book on a table.

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: Omar and Nina read a big picture book.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔和妮娜在看一本大图画书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt and Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress sit at a table with a large open picture book.

sentences.en: One page shows snow and ice on a mountain.
sentences.zh: 有一页画着山上的雪和冰。
sentences.scene_prompt: An open picture book page showing a tall mountain covered in snow and ice, seen over the shoulders of Omar, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt and Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress.

sentences.en: Next, a lion sleeps on the sunny grass.
sentences.zh: 接着，一头狮子睡在洒满阳光的草地上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture book page showing a lion sleeping on green grass under bright sun, Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress pointing at it.

sentences.en: A tall giraffe eats leaves from a tree.
sentences.zh: 一只高高的长颈鹿在吃树上的叶子。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture book page showing a tall giraffe eating leaves from a tree.

sentences.en: A little bird sits on the giraffe's head.
sentences.zh: 一只小鸟停在长颈鹿的头上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture book page showing a small bird sitting on top of a giraffe's head.

sentences.en: In the rain, small plants grow very fast.
sentences.zh: 在雨中，小植物长得很快。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture book page showing rain falling on small green plants sprouting from the ground.

sentences.en: A dog sleeps by a warm fire at Christmas.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节时，一只狗睡在温暖的炉火旁。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture book page showing a dog sleeping by a warm fireplace next to a Christmas tree.

sentences.en: Nina helps Omar understand the long words.
sentences.zh: 妮娜帮奥马尔弄懂那些长单词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress points at the book and explains while Omar, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt nods, understanding.
